added: Installable app (PWA): Add to Home Screen gives a real icon and standalone window; an app-shell cache makes loads instant while API and live sockets are never cached.
Custom vocabulary: teach the model exact-spelling names and jargon (Vocab button, up to 100 terms) applied to every dictation session.
Library search and Export all: find anything across Notes / Clips / Transcripts and download everything as Markdown or JSON.
Reset login: replace your phone or authenticator app yourself — needs a current code, erases the secret and recovery codes.
Screen stays awake while dictating (wake lock), and library rows get a native Share button on mobile.
Mobile polish: 44px touch targets, inputs no longer zoom-jump on iOS focus.

Self-healing link: the room now broadcasts an authoritative device roster, and a phone whose socket silently died while backgrounded is probed with a ping on return and hard-reconnects — the desktop showing 'Waiting' while the phone showed 'Linked' is fixed at both ends.
While the linked device dictates, the local button shows an amber 'Peer Talking…' state instead of offering a second microphone.
The Link dialog adapts to state: once a peer is linked, the QR/room-code invite hides and only 'join another room' remains; a restored session renders its QR again (the blank white panel on desktop).
changed: Mobile top bar wraps instead of overlapping around the live-acoustic badge, and the footer changelog link now reads as a link.

added: Room trust window: after a verified device opens Link Mode, the owner's other devices join that room with just the room code — QR scan or typed — for 12 hours, no second authenticator code needed.
changed: The header Link button is now a labeled, presence-driven control: Link (idle), pulsing amber Waiting (room open, no peer yet), emerald Linked (a device is actually connected) — instead of an icon-only button that read as connected while you were alone.
The view tabs (Studio / Notes / Clips / Transcripts) align with the editor panel's border, and the changelog page now uses the studio's full-width layout instead of a narrow centered column.
fixed: Phones could fail to join a room after reloads: mobile browsers leave ghost sockets behind, the room slowly filled with them and refused the reconnecting device. A rejoining device now always reclaims its slot.
security: The worker's direct /join route (which bypassed the app's login gate) is disabled unless explicitly opted in for local development.

added: Authenticator login: optionally protect device linking with a 6-digit code from Google/Microsoft Authenticator or any TOTP app, set up by scanning a QR code in the Link dialog.
Eight one-time recovery codes are shown once at setup, in case the authenticator is unavailable.
A verified login is remembered per browser for 12 hours; the link socket itself refuses connections without it.
A durable library: notes, clipboard clips, and transcript sessions are stored server-side and survive any refresh or device swap.
Notes / Clips / Transcripts views in a hash-routed navigation — dictation keeps running while you browse the library.
Pin, copy, and delete actions on every library entry; pinned entries stay on top.
A Save button that stores the current transcript as a note. Every clipboard push or receipt is captured as a clip automatically, and finishing a dictation session saves its transcript.
Remote-voice meter: the pill on the second screen now follows the linked device's voice in real time via tiny loudness frames over the link.
A dedicated /changelog page (this one), driven by changelog.json — the same file that feeds the header version seal.
Self-hosted fonts and animation library: the app loads with zero third-party requests.
Always-revalidate cache headers, so browsers can no longer serve stale app files (the blank QR box and phantom line-number errors).
Push now lands in both places on the receiving device: the transcript editor and the clipboard tray.
changed: Voice pill rebuilt: dB-mapped, log-spaced frequency bands with fast attack and slow release; silence shows a faint breathing floor instead of a fake wave.
The top-bar remote-dictation zone is permanently reserved and fades in with opacity, so the bar never reflows while words stream.
Dictation accuracy extras for quiet voices: voice-activity threshold, voice focus, and microphone auto-gain are configured per session.
fixed: The last dictated sentence no longer waits for the next one before syncing to the linked device (the stream's end-of-turn signal is now honored).
Hindi and other languages no longer bleed into English dictation (sessions are pinned to English via language_codes).
The manual join input accepts exactly 6 characters, matching the room-code format.
Refreshing the page no longer drops the link session; the room is restored automatically for 12 hours.
Idle connections stay alive with a 25-second heartbeat and recover with jittered backoff and tap-to-retry.
The tail of audio left under one batch is flushed when recording stops, so final words are no longer clipped.

added: Second AssemblyAI account key support: tokens are routed by the selected speech model.
changed: Link Mode state is visible in the top bar and can be left explicitly.
Security headers (CSP, frame, referrer, permissions policies) are enabled site-wide.
fixed: The Link Mode QR code renders reliably; the QR library is vendored locally.
Link pairing completes through the hello handshake even when sends queue at fetch time.

added: Link Mode: pair devices with a 6-character room code or QR and relay live dictation and clipboard between them.
SyncRoom Durable Object: room relay with snapshot catch-up for late joiners, hibernation-safe state, and a 12-hour room lifetime.
A same-origin /api/link/ws proxy so browsers connect to relay rooms without cross-origin sockets.
fixed: PCM batching no longer duplicates tail samples between batches.

added: Local draft resilience: the transcript survives accidental reloads.
changed: Resilient hybrid visualizer engine fusing live microphone data with synthetic harmonics.
Vāk & Nāda layout polish: side pillars, custom SVG theme icons, gold scrollbars, and a mid-rail toast slot.
